what: When the pointer is over button text, the text width is locked in place and the same letters, randomly shuffled, flash twice at 50ms intervals (all .1s) before returning to the real text. No other characters are pulled in, so the width stays nearly the same and spaces stay in place.

options.times: How many times the shuffled text is shown, default 2
options.every: How long each scrambled character stays (ms), default 50
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to mix (child, multiple allowed — like a name and a numeric tail). If empty, the element’s own text. Must be a text element with no tags inside

note: Not applied on touch devices (no hover) or reduced-motion settings

from.where: Header, bar and footer buttons on every page (original TextShuffle: iterations 2 · interval 50 · keepSpaces)
